description: Contract 5 — ack.toml. Input is the literal file TEXT; expected is the normalized parsed form (see spec/conformance/README.md for the shape) or a registered E4xx code. `raw_keys` asserts that unknown user sections survive parsing: `ack sync` must never destroy hand edits.

cases.note: Only [project] and [model] are required; every other field has a declared default. egress defaults to device — private by default is the default, not an opt-in.
Every section populated. A model ref splits on the FIRST colon only: ollama:gemma4:e4b-mlx is provider 'ollama', model 'gemma4:e4b-mlx'.

input.toml:
[project]
blueprint = "voice-care"
pack = "healthcare"

[model]
primary = "ollama:gemma4:e4b-mlx"
fallback = "cerebras:gemma-4-31b"

[policy]
egress = "device"
redactor = "healthcare.phi"

[capabilities]
enabled = ["voice", "extract"]

cases.note: Raising the boundary is allowed — deliberately, in the file, where a reviewer can see it.
Users and agents extend this file. Unknown sections and keys are preserved in raw so `ack sync` reconciles instead of overwriting.

input.toml:
[project]
blueprint = "on-device"
pack = "healthcare"
owner = "cardiology"

[model]
primary = "ollama:gemma4:e4b"

[team]
oncall = "dr-lin"

[deploy]
target = "clinic-laptop"

cases.note: An explicitly empty capability list is not the same file as an absent section, but it parses to the same value.
[project] and [model] are required; the runtime cannot pick a model without them.
The privacy boundary is defined over exactly device / trusted-network / public-cloud. A near-miss is refused, never coerced.
The file is meant to be hand-edited, so a syntax error is an expected condition with a named fix — not a stack trace.

Model references are provider-qualified: no separator, no reference. Note the limit of this check — a ref splits on the FIRST colon, so the bare Ollama tag 'gemma4:e4b' parses as provider 'gemma4' rather than failing. That ambiguity is inherent to the format, and the fix is the recommendation engine writing qualified refs, not a parser heuristic.
A provider with no model is as unusable as no provider.
Determinism (invariant 4): parse -> serialize -> parse -> serialize must reach a fixpoint, byte-identical, with the same normalized form. Agents navigate by convention and break on surprises.

input.toml:
[project]
blueprint = "voice-care"
pack = "healthcare"

[model]
primary = "ollama:gemma4:e4b-mlx"
fallback = "cerebras:gemma-4-31b"

[policy]
egress = "device"
redactor = "healthcare.phi"

[capabilities]
enabled = ["voice", "extract"]

cases.note: Round-tripping a minimal config fills in the declared defaults and then stops changing — the second serialization equals the first.
